-- class: expand

create unique index concurrently "books_pkey" on "s_76712e3b7c104ce0888b44cf0a648d26"."books" ("id");

-- class: expand
-- kind: add-constraint
-- action: ddl
-- lock: ACCESS EXCLUSIVE
